summary.lv: Betby meklē Integration Manager (spāņu valoda), kurš vadīs klientu tehnisko onboarding procesu, koordinēs iekšējās komandas un nodrošinās gludu integrāciju laicīgu piegādi.
summary.en: Betby is seeking a Spanish-speaking Integration Manager to guide clients through the technical onboarding and integration process, coordinating internal teams and ensuring timely, smooth integrations.
